about_short_description.short_description: Conscious Baboon is a health and wellness application that assists users in implementing sustainable healthy life habits for themselves.

product.name: Mindset Daily Breathwork & Mindset Practices
product.description: A daily program offering breathwork and mindset exercises to improve focus and reflection for fitness, work, and life.

product.name: Meal Planning & Nutrition Education
product.description: A service that helps users plan meals and learn nutrition tailored to their individual needs.

product.name: Goal Focused Functional Workouts
product.description: A workout program offering functional exercises aimed at building strength and endurance aligned with user goals.

product.name: Daily Stretching & Mobility Routines
product.description: A daily routine providing stretching and mobility exercises to support recovery and long-term physical health.

product.name: Habit Building Tools
product.description: Tools designed to help users build and maintain sustainable healthy habits across wellness areas.

product.name: Balance Monitoring
product.description: A feature that allows users to monitor their balance across four health pillars and adjust their routines accordingly.
